philosophy.epigraph: In myths and fairy tales, as in dreams, the psyche tells its own story, and the interplay of the archetypes is revealed in its natural setting as 'formation, transformation / the eternal Mind's eternal recreation.'

source.author: C. G. Jung
source.essay: The Phenomenology of the Spirit in Fairytales
source.publication: The Archetypes and the Collective Unconscious

philosophy.orientation: This knowledge graph exists to help people witness the psyche's own storytelling. It is not diagnostic. It does not pathologize. It illuminates the archetypal patterns already at work in dreams, reflections, and lived experience — making visible what the psyche is already doing.
